Story: Astrid Bloodaxe, the middle sister, is the most agile and impulsive of the trio. She grew up alongside Freya and Helga, training relentlessly and developing a deep-seated hatred for the Christian invaders who threatened their way of life. Astrid's quick wit and even quicker reflexes make her a formidable opponent, often seen leading the charge with her twin hand axes. Her loyalty to her sisters is absolute, and she would readily lay down her life for them and their shared cause. She finds joy in the thrill of battle and the camaraderie of her kin.
Residence: A shared longhouse in the village of Fjordskaal, Norway

BodyMarks.Name: Eyebrow Scar
